meta.title: Operation of Mechanical Shaker / Orbital Shaker in Pharmacognosy Laboratory

sections.purpose: To provide continuous mechanical agitation for extraction, maceration, and dissolution processes of plant materials and crude drugs to ensure uniform mixing and enhanced solute transfer.
sections.scope: Applicable to Pharmacognosy laboratory for maceration extraction, solubility testing, and preparation of herbal extracts requiring controlled agitation.
procedure: Inspect the shaker platform and clamps for cleanliness and mechanical integrity before use.
Place sample flasks or bottles on the shaker platform — ensure they are of uniform size and symmetrically arranged to balance the load.
Secure each flask/bottle firmly using the spring clamps or holddown clips to prevent displacement during shaking.
Cap all flasks tightly to prevent solvent evaporation — use PTFE-lined caps for organic solvents.
Set the desired speed (RPM) using the speed control knob — typical range for plant extraction: 100–200 RPM.
Set the required time on the timer if the shaker has a built-in timer; otherwise use an external stopwatch.
Switch ON the shaker and verify it starts smoothly without excessive vibration or wobble.
Allow the shaker to run for the specified extraction duration without unnecessary interruption.
At the end of the shaking period, switch OFF and allow the platform to come to a complete stop.
Carefully remove all flasks — caution if contents are under pressure (seal tightly before shaking volatile solvents).
Proceed immediately to filtration or further processing of the extract.
Clean the platform with a damp cloth; wipe with 70% alcohol if any spillage occurred.
Record speed, duration, solvent system, plant material, and extract yield in the laboratory logbook.
precautions: Balance the load symmetrically on the platform — asymmetric loading causes excessive vibration and motor damage.
Do not exceed the rated load capacity of the shaker platform.
Ensure all flasks are tightly stoppered before shaking — solvent spillage is a fire and health hazard.
For flammable organic solvents, use explosion-proof motors or perform extraction in a fume hood.
Secure the shaker on a stable, vibration-resistant bench surface.
Do not leave the shaker unattended for long periods when using volatile solvents.
Allow the platform to stop completely before removing flasks — remove flasks while platform is moving is dangerous.
